newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 10.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 10.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Video surveillance recordings could give a clue how a handgun and two clips of ammunition have disappeared from the Hungarian Parliament's guard room.
- The Hungarian Transport Minister has contacted his Russian counterpart to persuade Russian customs authorities to return 19 truck seized two and a half months ago.
- Police found several handguns, including an automatic one in a car at a petrol station near Budapest.
- Almost 70 entrepreneurs were killed in the last six years in Hungary. Most cases are connected with debt collection or turf disputes.
- Two armed men robbed a 27-year-old man of 13 million forints worth of foreign currency on the outskirts of Budapest.
